K-Matchup

Full-outing K projections from each starter’s arsenal against the opposing order. Arsenal K% is this pitcher’s mix vs this nine. The word chip (ELITE / STRONG / AVG / SOFT) is the solo grade from absolute K% bands — it does not depend on other pitchers today. The numeric # is only today’s slate rank (relative).
